documents.title: Runtime version and installation
documents.content: Use Node.js 26.5.x (see `.node-version`) and install the locked graph with `npm ci`.

documents.title: Pre-share verification
documents.content: Before sharing a change, run `npm run check` and `npm run frontend:build`.

documents.title: Regression test command
documents.content: `npm test` — run `node:test` suites in `tests/*.test.mjs`.

documents.title: Coding style
documents.content: Use ESM, strict TypeScript, two-space indentation, double quotes, semicolons, and trailing commas in multiline literals.

documents.title: Generated trees
documents.content: Do not commit generated trees such as `.build/`, `.cache/`, `dist/`, or `src/app/dist/`.

documents.title: Verification integrity
documents.content: Never weaken checksum, bundle-identity, signing, or clean-export checks to obtain a pass, and never commit credentials or local forensic evidence.

documents.title: Frontend source
documents.content: `frontend/` is the editable React/TypeScript reconstruction; it is not the checksum-pinned packaged renderer.

documents.title: Targeted test invocation
documents.content: Run a targeted test with `node --test tests/<name>.test.mjs`, then run the full check.
